		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 4 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason value = 3572 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_al_external_stage_receipts_verified var:zg361_we_al_external_stage_receipts_verified = 1 var:zg361_case_al_state >= 4 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 2 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 4 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason value = 3571 } }
}

# Append one genuinely closed portfolio cycle to the realm's
# rolling three-cycle ledger.  Receipt/hash authenticity is a typed caller
# input; this product persists and chains it, but does not claim cryptography.
zg361_we_append_completed_cycle_receipt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_adapter_status
	remove_variable = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_we_portfolio_closed
			has_variable = zg361_we_portfolio_status
			has_variable = zg361_we_final_conservation_ok
			var:zg361_we_portfolio_closed = 1
			var:zg361_we_portfolio_status = 6
			var:zg361_we_final_conservation_ok = 1
			var:zg361_case_al_active = 0
			var:zg361_case_al_state = 6
			var:zg361_case_al_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_case_al_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_case_al_cycle_serial = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_case_al_case_serial = $TICKET_CASE$
			$TICKET_SUBJECT$ = this
			$TICKET_OWNER$ = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_count var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_count > 0 }
					has_variable = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_tail_hash
					has_variable = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_cycle
					var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_tail_hash = $PREVIOUS_CHAIN_HASH$
					var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_cycle < $TICKET_CYCLE$
				}
				trigger_else = { $PREVIOUS_CHAIN_HASH$ = 0 }
			}
			$RECEIPT_ID$ > 0 $RECEIPT_HASH$ > 0 $NEW_CHAIN_HASH$ > 0
			NOT = { $NEW_CHAIN_HASH$ = $PREVIOUS_CHAIN_HASH$ }
		}
		$TICKET_OWNER$ = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_count } } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_count value = 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_count >= 3 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_cycle_1 value = var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_cycle_2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_subject_1 value = var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_subject_2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_case_1 value = var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_case_2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_receipt_id_1 value = var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_receipt_id_2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_previous_hash_1 value = var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_previous_hash_2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_receipt_hash_1 value = var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_receipt_hash_2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_chain_hash_1 value = var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_chain_hash_2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_cycle_2 value = var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_cycle_3 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_subject_2 value = var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_subject_3 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_case_2 value = var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_case_3 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_receipt_id_2 value = var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_receipt_id_3 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_previous_hash_2 value = var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_previous_hash_3 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_receipt_hash_2 value = var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_receipt_hash_3 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_chain_hash_2 value = var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_chain_hash_3 }
			}
			if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_count < 3 } change_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_count add = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_count = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_cycle_1 value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_subject_1 value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }

				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_receipt_id_1 value = $RECEIPT_ID$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_previous_hash_1 value = $PREVIOUS_CHAIN_HASH$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_receipt_hash_1 value = $RECEIPT_HASH$ }

			}
			else_if = {

				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_chain_hash_2 value = $NEW_CHAIN_HASH$ }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_cycle_3 value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_subject_3 value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_case_3 value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_receipt_id_3 value = $RECEIPT_ID$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_previous_hash_3 value = $PREVIOUS_CHAIN_HASH$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_receipt_hash_3 value = $RECEIPT_HASH$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_chain_hash_3 value = $NEW_CHAIN_HASH$ }
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_tail_hash value = $NEW_CHAIN_HASH$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_receipt_id value = $RECEIPT_ID$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_receipt_hash value = $RECEIPT_HASH$ }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $TICKET_OWNER$ = { has_variable = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_tail_hash has_variable = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_subject has_variable = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_case has_variable = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_receipt_id has_variable = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_receipt_hash var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$ var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_tail_hash = $NEW_CHAIN_HASH$ var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_case = $TICKET_CASE$ var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_receipt_id = $RECEIPT_ID$ var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_receipt_hash = $RECEIPT_HASH$ } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 2 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 4 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason value = 3611 } }
}

# #264 handoff evidence producer.  OUTCOME=1 is accepted; 2 is a
# rejected handoff.  An early settlement requires a distinct celestial waiver.
zg361_we_submit_m264_handoff_fact_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_adapter_status
	remove_variable = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ac_owner SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ac_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_state ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$ EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ EXPECTED_STATE = 6
			}
			$TICKET_OWNER$ = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
			$TICKET_SUBJECT$ = this
			trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_ready } var:zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_ready = 0 } trigger_else = { always = yes }
			has_variable = zg361_we_m254_contract_id
			has_variable = zg361_we_m254_sunset_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_we_m254_object_consumed
			var:zg361_we_m254_object_consumed = 1
			var:zg361_we_m254_contract_id = $CONTRACT_ID$
			var:zg361_we_m254_sunset_cycle = $SUNSET_CYCLE$
			OR = {
				$TICKET_OWNER$ = { has_variable = zg361_review_serial var:zg361_review_serial >= root.var:zg361_we_m254_sunset_cycle }
				AND = {
					$TICKET_OWNER$ = { has_variable = zg361_review_serial var:zg361_review_serial < root.var:zg361_we_m254_sunset_cycle }
					$WAIVER_ID$ > 0
					$WAIVER_APPROVER$ = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
					NOT = { $WAIVER_APPROVER$ = $PAYEE$ }
				}
			}
			OR = {
				AND = {
					$OUTCOME$ = 1
					$ACCEPTED_BY$ = $TICKET_OWNER$
					$PAYEE$ = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					$DOCUMENTATION_ID$ > 0 $DOCUMENTATION_HASH$ > 0
					$SHADOWING_ID$ > 0 $SHADOWING_HASH$ > 0
					$PRACTICAL_ID$ > 0 $PRACTICAL_HASH$ > 0
					NOT = { $DOCUMENTATION_ID$ = $SHADOWING_ID$ }
					NOT = { $DOCUMENTATION_ID$ = $PRACTICAL_ID$ }
					NOT = { $SHADOWING_ID$ = $PRACTICAL_ID$ }
				}
				AND = { $OUTCOME$ = 2 $REJECTION_REASON$ > 0 }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_ready value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_consumed value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_state value = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_contract_id value = $CONTRACT_ID$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_sunset_cycle value = $SUNSET_CYCLE$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_waiver_id value = $WAIVER_ID$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_waiver_approver value = $WAIVER_APPROVER$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_outcome value = $OUTCOME$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_accepted_by value = $ACCEPTED_BY$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_payee value = $PAYEE$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_documentation_id value = $DOCUMENTATION_ID$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_documentation_hash value = $DOCUMENTATION_HASH$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_shadowing_id value = $SHADOWING_ID$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_shadowing_hash value = $SHADOWING_HASH$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_practical_id value = $PRACTICAL_ID$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_practical_hash value = $PRACTICAL_HASH$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_handoff_rejection_reason value = $REJECTION_REASON$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 1 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 4 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason value = 2641 } }
}

# Internal subject-scope launch; ROOT is the eligible direct manager.
zg361_we_ac_launch_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied
	zg361_case_ac_open_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
		zg361_we_ac_initialize_effect = yes
		var:zg361_case_ac_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_we_ac_owner }
		save_scope_as = zg361_we_ac_subject
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_ac_cycle value = var:zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_ac_case value = var:zg361_case_ac_case_serial }
		zg361_we_ac_schedule_stage_01_deadline_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			zg361_we_ac_run_authorized_ai_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			scope:zg361_we_ac_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361we.254 } }
		}
	}
}

# Internal subject-scope launch; ROOT is the eligible direct manager.
zg361_we_ad_launch_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied
	zg361_case_ad_open_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
		zg361_we_ad_initialize_effect = yes
		var:zg361_case_ad_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_we_ad_owner }
		save_scope_as = zg361_we_ad_subject
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_ad_cycle value = var:zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_ad_case value = var:zg361_case_ad_case_serial }
		zg361_we_ad_schedule_stage_01_deadline_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			zg361_we_ad_run_authorized_ai_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			scope:zg361_we_ad_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361we.266 } }
		}
	}
}

# Internal subject-scope launch; ROOT is the eligible direct manager.
zg361_we_al_launch_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied
	zg361_case_al_open_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
		zg361_we_al_initialize_effect = yes
		var:zg361_case_al_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_we_al_owner }
		save_scope_as = zg361_we_al_subject
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_al_cycle value = var:zg361_case_al_cycle_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_al_case value = var:zg361_case_al_case_serial }
		zg361_we_al_schedule_stage_01_deadline_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			zg361_we_al_run_authorized_ai_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			scope:zg361_we_al_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361we.355 } }
		}
	}
}

	}
